notes: Tuition page lists 'Engineering Physics' among fee-liable programmes. Fee shown as per semester (150000 minor units); DAAD page gives 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU; English programme page gives €1,500 per semester for non-EU; so €3,000/year. Semester contribution of approx. 160 EUR is separate, not tuition. Application channel: the DAAD page says 'VDP from uni-assist' (typo for VPD) and the German international-applicants page mandates a Zeugnisbewertung (VPD) via uni-assist for all foreign degrees. Exact deadline for this intake is 30 September 2026 for winter semester 2026/2027. One quote used as evidence is a longer concatenated passage from the English listing spanning the degree admission requirements; its substrings are exact copies.
